title: The 1947 big band for the Negro theaters
summary: McRae built a single big band for Gale, Schiffman and Glaser to play the Apollo, Howard and Uptown theaters.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit

But from your recordings in 1956, you didn't record between that time. You, yourself, didn't really record very much until "Mr. Bear."
No, I didn't anything up (inaudible) after that.
During '46 and '47, that's when I built that big band. That's when I had the big band. I only had that one big band.

I had a thing from Moe Gale, Schiffman, and Joe Glaser to do all the theaters like Washington, D.C. -- the Negro theaters like Washington, Philadelphia, Baltimore and Washington and the Apollo Theater --
